metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) over Los Angeles lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Three periods: Oct 1-23 for 2018, 2019, and 2021 - Location: Los Angeles (approximate center: 34.05°N, 118.24°W) 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag (qa_value >= 0.75) to filter valid pixels - NO2 column is in the 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' band 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NO2 for each period - Check if 2021 < both 2018 AND 2019 → Answer A - Otherwise → Answer B - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid values) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Los Angeles geometry const la = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.24, 34.05]).buffer(50000); // 50km radius // Define time periods const periods = { '2018': ['2018-10-01', '2018-10-24'], '2019': ['2019-10-01', '2019-10-24'], '2021': ['2021-10-01', '2021-10-24'] }; const results = {}; // Process each period for (const [year, dates] of Object.entries(periods)) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(dates[0], dates[1]) .filterBounds(la) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { console.log(`No images for ${year}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Apply quality masking and calculate mean const masked = col.map(function(img) { const qa = img.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_validity'); return img.updateMask(qa.gte(75)); }); const mean = masked.mean(); // Check valid pixel count const stats = mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: la, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count = stats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; const value = stats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; if (!count || count === 0) { console.log(`No valid pixels for ${year}`); console.log("C2"); return; } if (value === null || value === undefined || isNaN(value)) { console.log(`Invalid calculation for ${year}`); console.log("C3"); return; } results[year] = { count: count, value: value, size: size }; console.log(`${year}: Images=${size}, Pixels=${count}, NO2=${(value * 1e6).toFixed(2)} μmol/m²`); } // Compare 2021 vs 2018 and 2019 const lower_than_2018 = results['2021'].value < results['2018'].value; const lower_than_2019 = results['2021'].value < results['2019'].value; if (lower_than_2018 && lower_than_2019) { console.log("2021 NO2 was lower than both 2018 and 2019"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("2021 NO2 was NOT lower than both comparison years"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
